name: GradientInput
description: A gradient chip beside a summary of the gradient (angle and stop count). Clicking either opens the gradient editor (stops, colors, angle) in a popover.
usage: Use for choosing a linear gradient, e.g. a fill or a shine layer
onChange(gradient) is called with the whole new GradientValue, value first
Controlled with value, or uncontrolled with defaultValue (default black to white at 90°)
Use lockedHue to vary only the alpha of each stop (shine/gloss effects); minStops and maxStops bound the stops
It has no native field: the ref, the id and unnamed props (aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) go to the chip, its focusable root
design: The chip shows the gradient; the summary beside it reads '<angle>°, <n> stops' and also opens the editor
The editor opens in a portalled popover beside the chip, on whichever side has room
Sizes from the input scale ('2xs' to 'lg', utils/inputSizing.ts), default 'md'; compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'
Keyboard ring on the chip: 2px var(--color-border-focus), offset 2px on var(--color-surface-canvas)
Error state: var(--color-error) borders and message; disabled: a transparent chip, var(--color-text-disabled) text
accessibility: The chip is a button named 'Edit <label> gradient' (or by aria-label / aria-labelledby passed through), with aria-expanded and aria-haspopup="dialog"
The editor is a role="dialog"; Escape closes it and returns focus to the chip
aria-describedby on the chip points at the error or helper (merged with any passed in)
disabled sets the native disabled on the chip

props.name: id
props.description: The chip's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the gradient ({ angle, stops }). Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the gradient at first (default black to white at 90°)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole new gradient

props.name: error
props.description: The app's error message: shows at once unless touched is false; replaces the helper text

props.name: helperText
props.description: Text displayed below the input when not in an error state.

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show an error the app passes at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left. false hides errors

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required (adds asterisk to label).

props.name: disabled
props.description: The chip natively disabled; the editor doesn't open; nothing fires

props.name: lockedHue
props.description: Lock all stops to this hex hue; only alpha varies (shine/gloss effects)

props.name: className
props.description: CSS classes for the outer container, merged with cn() so yours win

props.name: chipClassName
props.description: CSS classes for the gradient chip <button>

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (aria-*, data-*, onFocus…) goes to the chip
